title: Scaffolder: Add domains support
description: When picking a GW as runtime, the scaffolder should verify if the parametrized GW has an already defined `http:config`, and if it has it, it should use it.    As it is right now, when generating the xml with the `http:config` with a GW that already has another `http:config` there (a) might be an issue of ports already in use and (b) we are not behaving as expected when selecting a GW runtime.    Ideally, we should unify the scaffolder so that there is no repeated codebase between APIKit for SOAP and APIKit, centralizing the root behaviour in one place.

title: Rewrite baseUri when requesting raml, to use relative path
description: This ticket is part of the output of this spike: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NlMa5PSEyTouY3pJJzgno9Ac3L-UgRI4sZ1SN6-zEtk/edit    Basically, if a cloudhub user wants to retrieve the console and use it, the cloudhub console wiil always try to hit your-app.cloudhub.io, even if you are hitting the worker directly.     To solve this, if the console and api share the same scheme, host , domain and port, we will send the relative path of the api, so the rest of the baseUri will be taken from the console uri, by the browser.     Steps to reproduce:  - Create an app. Make sure the console and api uses the same scheme, host , domain and port.  -  upload it to cloudhub  - Hit the worker directly, and request the console (To hit the worker, you have to use """"mule-worker-"""" + your app, for example: mule-worker-myapp.cloudhub.io)  - Try to make a request with it    Expected:  The console will work and will retrieve the data you requested    Actual:  The request cannot be done    For more information about cloudhub routing, visit: https://docs.mulesoft.com/runtime-manager/cloudhub-networking-guide

title: Console source location should be saved to a file
description: We should save every console source into a single txt file, as all the previous versions of APIKit do.    The location of this file should be inside of the .mule folder, inside of the data of each application.   (Remember that each application may have several consoles)         If the host of the console is 0.0.0.0, we should replace it by following this logic:    Cloudhub   * The host should always be the one specified by cloudhub (by using the property fullDomain)    Standalone   * it should be replaced with localhost    If the user specified a host different than 0.0.0.0, it should't be replaced
